newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was moderate late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers finished $1.00 lower than last week.

Inquiry ws moderate, demand was rather light. Sales confirmed on 12,300 slaughter steers and 13,600 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 32,500 head confirmed including 9,200 head or about 28 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.s
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1125-1325 lbs 63.00, pen 64.00; load select with end choice 1150 lbs cutting bulls 62.50.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1200 lbs 63.00, pen 64.00; pen mixed commercial to choice 1025-1100 lbs heifers and heiferettes 62.50.
week to date: 32500 last week: 15800 last year: 15000
